intro: Mock paper. Answer every question in the spaces provided. Show your working: marks are given for method. The marks for each question are shown in brackets.

questions.q: Work out 2 2/3 × 1 1/8, giving your answer in its simplest form.
A price is reduced by 15% to £61.20. Find the original price.
For 8, 13, 18, ... find the nth term and the sum of the first 30 terms.
L passes through (2, −1) and (6, 7). Find the line perpendicular to L through (6, 7).
y is inversely proportional to x². y = 10 when x = 3. Find y when x = 5.
